### `application/json` — Default

Sample portal update request

```json
{
  "portals": [
    {
      "name": "updateportal",
      "saml_configuration": {
        "login_url": "https://www.example.com",
        "logout_url": "https://www.example.com",
        "public_key": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----------END CERTIFICATE-----",
        "active": true
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
